title: penv project settings
description: Project-wide configuration for project-env-utils (tracked in git).

name.description: Project identifier. Used as the namespace for local cache folders and the SQLite database.

op_item_prefix.description: Prefix prepended to every 1Password item title (e.g. 'myproj' → items named 'myproj/my-api'). Leave empty to use bare service names.

bucket.description: Bucket name used by external secret backends.

services.description: List of services managed by this project.

name.description: Service name — must match the repo folder name adjacent to the penv binary.

description.description: Human-readable description stored as the item note in 1Password.

env_vars.description: Key names shown in the show-info box and 1Password item template.

env_path.description: Path to the .env file relative to the service repo root. Defaults to '.env' when absent.

files.description: Additional sensitive files managed alongside the .env (e.g. TLS certificates, signing keys).

dev_ui.description: Configuration for the dev-ui tmux session.

repo.description: Repo folder name for the UI service.

pane_dev_cmd.description: Command run in the dev pane (e.g. 'npm run dev').

pane_sb_cmd.description: Command run in the Storybook pane (e.g. 'npm run storybook').

panes.description: Grid panes for the dev-ui session.

dev_backend.description: Configuration for the dev-backend tmux session.

pane_git_cmd.description: Command run in each pane of the auto-generated 'git' window (e.g. 'lazygit'). Omit to skip the git window.

sessions.description: Flexible grid sessions launched via 'penv dev-session'.

vscode.description: VS Code workspace generation config. Used by 'penv workspace open/wizard'.

output_file.description: Filename (relative to the repo parent directory) for the generated workspace file.

peacock_color.description: Hex color for the VS Code Peacock extension (e.g. '#a0927a'). Emitted as peacock.color in the workspace settings block.

extra_settings.description: Arbitrary VS Code workspace settings merged verbatim into the 'settings' block of every generated workspace file (e.g. workbench.colorCustomizations, files.exclude).

groups.description: Named repo groups for --group <name>=<branch>. When absent, 'ui' (from dev_ui.repo) and 'backend' (from dev_backend) are auto-derived.

repos.description: Service repo names belonging to this group.

extra_folders.description: Repos beyond the penv services to include by default. Each path is relative to the repo parent directory.

name.description: Display name shown in VS Code's Explorer sidebar. Defaults to the folder basename.

path.description: Folder path relative to the repo parent directory.

presets.description: Named subsets of repos. Use 'penv workspace open --preset <name>' to open one. Saved automatically by 'penv workspace wizard --save <name>'.

folders.description: Repos/folders to include. Each entry is either a bare repo name (string) or an object with a per-folder worktree branch override.

oneOf.description: Repo name matching a service name or extra_folder path/name. Uses the global --branch when --worktree is active.
Pin this repo to a specific worktree branch, independent of --branch.

claude.description: Linked-window config that attaches an external tmux session window (e.g. a Claude Code session) into dev sessions.

session_name.description: External tmux session to link from.

window.description: Window name or index within the external session. Defaults to session_name when empty.

cmd.description: Command to run when the external session is auto-created on first launch.

ticket_manager.description: Optional ticket manager integration. When configured, dev session info boxes show an 'open_ticket' command that opens the ticket URL extracted from the current branch name.

pattern.description: Regex applied to the branch name to extract the ticket ID (first match). Examples: Wrike numeric: "\\d+", Jira: "[A-Z]+-\\d+".

url_template.description: URL template where {ticket} is replaced with the matched ID. Example: "https://www.wrike.com/open.htm?id={ticket}".

secretFile.description: A sensitive file tracked by the secret backend alongside the .env.

label.description: Short identifier used as the storage key. Must be unique within the service.

path.description: Path to the file relative to the service repo root (e.g. 'keys/signing.key').

shared.description: When true, the file content is identical across all presets and is stored once. When false (default), a separate copy is kept per preset.

repo.description: Repo folder name relative to repo_parent().

cmd.description: Command to run in the pane. Empty = idle shell.

repo.description: Repo folder name relative to repo_parent(). Empty = working dir stays at repo_parent().

cmd.description: Command to run in the pane. Empty = idle shell.

name.description: Window name shown in the tmux status bar.

panes.description: Panes to place in the grid. Gaps become idle shells automatically.

no_preset.description: Skip preset resolution and env sync — for sessions that don't use secrets.

message.description: Custom message shown in the infobox (word-wrapped), displayed above the notes section.
